# Eurex Reference Data API

> Read-only GraphQL API with Eurex reference data (products, contracts, trading hours, holidays, tick rules, TES parameters, settlement prices). Authentication: header X-DBP-APIKEY (the page offers a shared demo key; users can get their own free key on the developer portal). Start with the AI instructions page.

## For AI agents

- [AI instructions (plain text)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ViktorHD/eurex-api/main/ai.md): same content as ai.html. Endpoint, authentication, datasets, query syntax, recipes, error handling and rules for assistants. Read this first.

- [AI instructions (web page)](ai.html): the same content as a page for people.

## Tools

- [API Explorer](./): run queries and browse products, trading hours and calendars in the browser.

## More

- [Eurex: free reference data API](https://www.eurex.com/ex-en/data/free-reference-data-api): official description.
- [Notebooks](https://github.com/ViktorHD/eurex-api/tree/main/notebooks): tutorial and recipes with working queries.
